gloss: bottom of one's heart; the depths of one's feelings

definitions.gloss: bottom of one's heart; the depths of one's feelings
definitions.explanation: The deepest part of one's emotions or thoughts. Used to emphasize the sincerity or intensity of a feeling, often with the particle から (from) to mean 'from the bottom of one's heart.'

examples.japanese: {心|こころ}の{底|そこ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}する→感謝する：06055_kanshasuru⟧。
examples.english: I thank you from the bottom of my heart.

examples.japanese: {心|こころ}の{底|そこ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じていた→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: Deep down, I was feeling anxious.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{無事|ぶじ}→無事：01602_buji⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧、{心|こころ}の{底|そこ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦ほっとした→ほっとする：07652_hottosuru⟧。
examples.english: When I heard he was safe, I felt truly relieved from the bottom of my heart.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly used with the particle ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ to form {心|こころ}の{底|そこ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ (from the bottom of one's heart). Also used with ⟦では→では：02945_deha⟧ to express hidden or deep-seated feelings that may not be outwardly shown.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {心|こころ}の{底|そこ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{願|ねが}う→願う：02387_negau⟧ (to wish from the bottom of one's heart)
- {心|こころ}の{底|そこ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{喜|よろこ}ぶ→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧ (to rejoice from the bottom of one's heart)
- {心|こころ}の{底|そこ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{思|おも}っている→思う：00492_omou⟧ (to think deep down)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{本心|ほんしん}→本心：12864_honshin⟧: one's true feelings — focuses on what one genuinely thinks
- ⟦{心底|しんそこ}→心底：21958_shinsoko⟧: from the bottom of one's heart — a more literary synonym, used adverbially
